entrevistaIa.title: Smart interview
entrevistaIa.intro: Chat with the TopLynk assistant: type free-text answers. It will guide you until your profile is ready for matching (goals, moment, area, how you like to connect, distance, and follow-ups).
entrevistaIa.errorP3: Describe your main area in a short sentence.
entrevistaIa.phase1Complete: Phase 1 complete. Thanks for your answers!
entrevistaIa.phase2Soon: Next, the AI will generate tailored questions from what you shared (per our matching flow). For now, you can explore the app.
entrevistaIa.f2Handoff: Great. I'll tailor a few follow-up questions based on what you shared.
entrevistaIa.f2Error: We couldn't generate questions right now. Check your connection or try again.
entrevistaIa.f2ErrorNoApiUrl: To use the AI interview, set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL in the app's .env (Nest API base URL, e.g. http://192.168.x.x:3000) and OPENAI_API_KEY in the API's .env. See .env.example in apps/mobile and apps/api.
entrevistaIa.phase2Complete: Interview complete! Your answers will help with matching.
entrevistaIa.chatErrorApi: Could not complete the interview turn. Check your connection, EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL, and API logs.
entrevistaIa.chatError401: OpenAI rejected the key on the server (401). In apps/api/.env check OPENAI_API_KEY (sk-...), billing/quota; add OPENAI_ORG_ID / OPENAI_PROJECT_ID if required.
entrevistaIa.chatError429: OpenAI rate limit reached. Wait a moment or check your account quota/plan.
entrevistaIa.chatError502: The API could not get a valid response from OpenAI. Retry or check server logs.
entrevistaIa.chatError503: The API is not configured for OpenAI (missing OPENAI_API_KEY in apps/api/.env).
entrevistaIa.chatErrorNetwork: Network error calling the API. Check EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (on a real device use your machine's IP, not localhost).
entrevistaIa.profileIncomplete: Almost there — some structured fields are still missing (goals, moment, area, in-person/remote/hybrid, or distance). Reply once more spelling those out clearly.

p1.question: What are you looking for here? (you can pick more than one)

p2.question: What best describes your current professional moment?

p3.question: What is your main area? (e.g. Technology, Sales, Legal — or write your own.)

p4.question: How do you prefer to work/connect?

p5.question: What distance feels ideal for nearby connections?
